records.subject: Guest-atom filling fraction or occupancy
records.object: Guest-species capacity to fill CoSb3 voids
records.conditions: Nominal M0.1Co4Sb12 (M = La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Yb, Eu); occupancies from SR-PXRD structure refinement at 90–700 K
records.quote: Partially filled skutterudites with nominal compositions of M0.1Co4Sb12 (M = La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Yb; and Eu) were investigated by multitemperature (90-700 K) synchrotron radiation powder x-ray diffraction (SR-PXRD), and electrical and thermal transport property, heat capacity, and Hall effect measurements were also taken.
context_quotes: The filling fractions, i.e., the occupancy factors of the guest atoms, were obtained from structure refinement of the SR-PXRD data, and they reflect the capacity for the individual guest atom species to fill the voids of the CoSb3 structure.

records.subject: Weakly bonded guest atoms
records.object: Anomalously large guest-atom atomic displacement parameters
records.conditions: Guests in nominal M0.1Co4Sb12 (M = La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Yb, Eu); multitemperature SR-PXRD at 90–700 K
records.quote: Partially filled skutterudites with nominal compositions of M0.1Co4Sb12 (M = La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Yb; and Eu) were investigated by multitemperature (90-700 K) synchrotron radiation powder x-ray diffraction (SR-PXRD), and electrical and thermal transport property, heat capacity, and Hall effect measurements were also taken.
context_quotes: Anomalously large atomic displacement parameters (ADPs) are observed for the weakly bonded guest atoms, in agreement with the rattling concept, but no correlation is observed between the magnitude of the ADP and the ionic radius of the guest atom.

Einstein and Debye temperatures were derived from analysis of the multitemperature ADPs of guest atoms and the framework atoms, respectively, and this analysis also shows that neither the guest atoms nor the host structure atoms contain large disorder contributions to their ADPs.
modality_evidence: Partially filled skutterudites with nominal compositions of M0.1Co4Sb12 (M = La, Ce, Nd, Sm, Yb; and Eu) were investigated by multitemperature (90-700 K) synchrotron radiation powder x-ray diffraction (SR-PXRD), and electrical and thermal transport property, heat capacity, and Hall effect measurements were also taken.
